subject: SSL: certificate verification failed (result: 5) installing devtools

messages.author: 0dd6c9694b3c4809
messages.subject: SSL: certificate verification failed (result: 5) installing devtools
parts:
devtools::document("~/bin/umx"); devtools::install("~/bin/umx");
Updating umx documentation
Loading umx
unloadNamespace("umx") not successful. Forcing unload.
Error in importIntoEnv(pkgenv, exports, nsenv, exports) : 
  cannot add bindings to a locked environment

devtools::install_github("hadley/devtools")
Installing github repo hadley/devtools@master from hadley
Downloading devtools.zip from https://api.github.com/repos/hadley/devtools/zipball/master
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  SSL: certificate verification failed (result: 5)

this was with 
packageVersion("devtools")
[1] ‘1.5.0.99’

I updated from CRAN and restarted R
install.packages("devtools")
packageVersion("devtools")
[1] ‘1.5’

but identical error

I am on R version: R version 3.1.1 (2014-07-10) (x86_64-apple-darwin10.8.0)

PS: with error
devtools::install_github("devtools")
Error: Repo name should look like username/repo

you might add "for instance 'hadley/devtools' "

parts:
Thanks for the info. I'm on Yosemite too and have been having the same issue.

I just managed to use install_git as a temporary workaround. So you could try
devtools::install_git("https://github.com/hadley/devtools.git")

I believe you need git, which would come with Xcode or you can install standalone.

Best,
